sloka: सौमित्रे शोभते पम्पा वैदूर्य विमल उदका ।फुल्ल पद्म उत्पलवती शोभिता विविधैः द्रुमैः ॥४-१-३॥
transliteration: saumitre śobhate pampā vaidūrya vimala udakā ।phulla padma utpalavatī śobhitā vividhaiḥ drumaiḥ ॥4-1-3॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri Pampa looks beautiful with its water clear as vaidurya, its lilies and lotuses in full bloom and its trees in all their variety.
